postal_system.legal_rule: Pos Malaysia provides the operational five-digit postcode and locality lookup. The MyGDX catalog describes postcode-locality data sourced from Pos Malaysia but requires provider approval. The UPU sheet places five digits before the locality and documents P.O. box, locked bag, poste restante and window-ticket delivery objects. These establish syntax, dated assignment evidence and address order, not canonical polygons, exact civic addresses, building relations, complete history or blanket redistribution rights.
postal_system.assignment_rule: Every postcode is stored as a five-character digit string with leading zeroes preserved. A production assignment requires an exact current Pos Malaysia result or provider-approved MyGDX row with authority, locality, validity, retrieval time, response schema and digest pinned. Prefixes, equal names, UPI parcel codes, MyGeoName labels, office points, coordinates, administrative overlap and nearest features do not create a postcode assignment, postal area or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No reviewed canonical national Malaysia postcode polygon artifact is bundled. An official postal surface requires an exact postal-authority boundary artifact and five-digit code relation with authority, edition, coverage, rights, CRS, topology and digest pinned. Joining an exact postcode-locality assignment to a MyGeo state, division, district, jajahan, mukim, town or pekan boundary is a source-composed administrative join surface, not a postal-authority polygon. Voronoi, interpolation and model surfaces remain derived and uncertainty-bearing; UPI parcels, MyGOS layers, MyGeoName labels and OSM never become official postcode polygons.
postal_system.address_rule: Recipient, organization, building, floor or unit, house or lot number, street or jalan, section or seksyen, village or kampung, neighbourhood or taman, locality, district or jajahan or division, state or federal territory, postal-service object and five-digit postcode remain typed and validity-aware. A postcode, administrative row, UPI parcel, coordinate or map label alone does not identify a recipient, owner, occupant, entrance, unit or exact legal civic address.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building display requires an explicit rights-cleared civic-address identifier, separately permitted building geometry, and a provider-defined stable relation, common identifier or reviewed explicit crosswalk. MyGOS map buildings, UPI parcels, address strings, administrative containment, coordinate equality, proximity and nearest-building logic are candidates or validation evidence only and never establish an exact address-building relation.
postal_system.licence_rule: Pos Malaysia, UPU, MyGDX, MyGeoportal, MyGOS, UPI and MyGeoName pages are reference evidence until exact reuse terms are recorded. MyGDX APIs require provider approval, MyGOS is a secure G2G environment, spatial products follow provider release policy, and MyGDI documents pricing and copyright licence agreements. Viewing, searching, registering, requesting, paying or attributing never grants blanket row, map, address or building redistribution rights.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Recipients, senders, P.O. box or locked-bag holders, postcode and shipping query records, phones, emails, identity data, households, residents, owners, occupants, tenants, parcel-right holders, cadastral records, access credentials, tracking records and private premises are excluded from public artifacts. Only explicitly public or licensed non-personal fields may enter a production pack.
